chunks: ʿUthmān ibn ʿĪsā, from Samāʿah, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
“Regarding the back, if it is broken such that its owner can no longer emit semen, then the full blood money is due.”

key_terms.كَامِلَةً: full; meaning the complete diyah is owed
key_terms.كُسِرَ: was broken; indicating a severe fracture or break
key_terms.يُنْزِلَ: to emit semen; referring to the loss of sexual/reproductive function
key_terms.ٱلدِّيَةُ: blood money; the prescribed financial compensation for bodily injury
key_terms.ٱلظَّهْرِ: the back; the bodily area whose injury is being legally assessed
key_terms.ٱلْمَاءَ: semen; used here in the legal sense of seminal fluid

ai.seo_question: What is the diyah for a broken back that causes loss of seminal emission in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning compensation for a severe back injury. If the back is broken to the extent that the injured person can no longer emit semen, the full diyah is required.
